At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold  “what if.”  
 What if  your ideas could ignite global innovation? 
 What if  your curiosity could redefine the future? 

 We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of  your  career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our  cloud -first  networking  and security solutions already protect  70% of the Fortune 500 , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career. 

 Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary:  Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running  — and what we build is world-class:  recognized  as  CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024  —   evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So,  what if  the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”. 

 In a world where you can be anything,  Be Infoblox . 

 Associate Software Engineer 

 We are looking for an Associate Software Engineer to join our Universal Asset Insights team, located in Burnaby, BC, reporting to the Manager of Engineering. In this role, you will contribute to Infoblox Universal Asset Insights, which automates the discovery and analysis of both IP-based and non-IP-based assets across public clouds, on-premises networks, IoT/OT devices, and third-party applications. Integrated with Infoblox's critical network services, including DNS, DHCP, and IPAM, it enhances network visibility and IPAM accuracy. You will work closely with Product Management and engineering leadership to execute the product roadmap and engineering goals of building scalable, reliable, and maintainable software.

 You are the ideal candidate if you are a great collaborator, eager to learn, able to execute assigned work with guidance, and committed to delivering high-quality results.

 Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do 

 
 Contribute to the development of cloud-hosted data ingestion, transformation, and normalization pipelines built to scale, perform, and remain reliable

 Contribute to building extensible frameworks that enable low-code/no-code integrations, allowing customers and partners to build new asset sources

 Collaborate with cross-functional and global engineering teams to build reusable software components that can be delivered as a platform

 Support productivity and innovation through the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic approaches across the software development lifecycle, including design, development, quality assurance, automation, deployment, observability, maintenance, and troubleshooting

 Contribute to product innovation through the adoption of agentic infrastructure into product capabilities, including agents, sub-agents, tool integrations, and reusable skills

 Contribute to product architecture and software design discussions, helping ensure the delivery of scalable, extensible, and reliable systems

 Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing on roadmap, documentation, and other collateral

 Stay up to date on key trends in asset insights, no-code/low-code approaches for remediation, data transformation, ETL, agentic AI, and related areas

 
 Be Prepared — What You Bring 

 
 Experience developing software using modern programming languages and engineering practices, including service-oriented architectures, containerized deployment environments, and event-driven or asynchronous processing

 Experience building or contributing to cloud-hosted software, SaaS products, data ingestion and transformation workflows, asset management systems, or other data-intensive applications

 Working knowledge of data modeling, APIs, system architecture, and software design

 Familiarity with relational, time-series, NoSQL, or graph-oriented data stores

 Experience contributing to performance improvements, troubleshooting production issues, or improving the reliability of software systems

 Strong interest in learning new technical domains, including networking concepts such as switching, routing, security, DNS, DHCP, and IPAM. Networking experience is not required

 Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams across different time zones

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; a master's degree is preferred

 Preferred qualifications

 Hands-on experience applying AI or agentic engineering approaches to improve software development, automation, performance, reliability, or product capabilities

 
 Be Successful — Your Path 

 First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), map the systems, and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals.

 Six Months: Develop a strong understanding of the Infoblox Asset Insights product offering. Design and develop assigned features with appropriate guidance, contribute to code and design reviews, and identify productivity and extensibility enhancements for integrations and adapters.

 One Year: Deliver meaningful features toward extensibility to rapidly onboard integrations, make contributions toward architecture and design improvements, improve productivity, quality, and reliability, and collaborate closely with Product Management to identify areas for research and development.

 Belong— Your Community 

 Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward.

 In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

 Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong 

 
 Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options

 Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops

 Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy

 Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations

 Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

 We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications. Base salary for this position: $ 73,100 - $105,380 CAD plus annual bonus.

 
 Ready to Be the Difference? 

 Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.
